description: This file defines the LDAPConfigModel class, which is a data model representing LDAP configuration settings within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin. It implements a method to serialize the configuration into an array, including LDAP settings and data mappings.

classes.name: LDAPConfigModel
classes.description: A class representing LDAP configuration settings, capable of normalizing its data into an array format suitable for serialization or API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting LDAPSetting dependency into the model.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts LDAP configuration data into an associative array for serialization, including settings and data mappings.
